name: safe-net
description: Safe-Net — cybersecurity LMS, phishing simulator, and the SafeNet Guard browser extension

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:i18n
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run test && bun run test:secrets && bun run build && bun run test:package
scripts.dev: bun run db:up && concurrently -n api,web,ml -c cyan,magenta,yellow --kill-others-on-fail "bun:dev:api" "bun:dev:web" "bun:dev:ml"
scripts.dev:no-ml: bun run db:up && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "bun:dev:api" "bun:dev:web"
scripts.dev:ml: cd ml-service && { [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || { echo '[ml] no .venv — run \"bun run setup:ml\", or use \"bun run dev:no-ml\"'; exit 0; }; } && exec .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 --reload
scripts.start: bun run db:up && bun run build:api && bun run build:web && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "bun:start:api" "bun:start:web"
scripts.start:api: cd server && NODE_ENV=production bun run prod
scripts.setup: bun run install:all && bun run config:local && bun run db:up && cd server && bunx prisma generate && bunx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.setup:demo: bun run setup && cd server && bunx prisma db seed
scripts.setup:ml: cd ml-service && python3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -U pip && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build: bun run package:ext && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "bun:build:api" "bun:build:web"
scripts.test:ml: cd ml-service && { [ -x .venv/bin/python ] || { echo '[ml] missing .venv — run bun run setup:ml'; exit 1; }; } && .venv/bin/python scripts/test_scoring.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/test_parity.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/test_privacy.py && .venv/bin/python scripts/evaluate.py --mode rules
